title: New Foundations refutes the Weak Partition Principle
abstract: Constructs a formal first-order derivation of the negation of the Weak Partition Principle from New Foundations, with extensionality and the full integer-stratified comprehension schema. Proves full deductive equivalence with Metamath's Hailperin-derived finite presentation, including its added singleton axiom. Replays the source proof through nominal syntax, explicit freshness certificates, and a de Bruijn calculus. Includes reusable first-order soundness and completeness, stratification, lowering, and proof-translation infrastructure. This is a derivability theorem; it does not assert the consistency of New Foundations.

informal.NFChoice.Foundation.NFStandard.NF_proves: Standard New Foundations formally derives the negation of WPP. WPP says that, for all sets x and y, if a function maps y onto x and an injective function maps y into x, then an injective function maps x into y.
informal.NFChoice.Foundation.NFStandard.nf_hailpe: Extensionality together with every integer-stratified comprehension instance and Metamath's Hailperin-derived finite first-order presentation, including its added singleton axiom, derive exactly the same sentences.
